import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static long MOD;

    static class Mod {
        long x;

        Mod(long val) {
            if (MOD != 0 && (val >= MOD || val < 0)) {
                val %= MOD;
                if (val < 0) val += MOD;
            }
            x = val;
        }

        static Mod pow(Mod a, long e) {
            long b = a.x, r = 1;
            while (e > 0) {
                if ((e & 1) == 1) r = r * b % MOD;
                b = b * b % MOD;
                e >>= 1;
            }
            return new Mod(r);
        }

        Mod add(Mod o) {
            return new Mod(x + o.x);
        }

        Mod sub(Mod o) {
            return new Mod(x - o.x);
        }

        Mod mul(Mod o) {
            return new Mod(x * o.x % MOD);
        }

        Mod div(Mod o) {
            if (o.x == 0) throw new ArithmeticException("Division by zero");
            return this.mul(pow(o, MOD - 2));
        }

        Mod addAssign(Mod o) {
            x += o.x;
            if (x >= MOD) x -= MOD;
            return this;
        }

        Mod subAssign(Mod o) {
            x += MOD - o.x;
            if (x >= MOD) x -= MOD;
            return this;
        }

        Mod mulAssign(Mod o) {
            x = x * o.x % MOD;
            return this;
        }

        Mod divAssign(Mod o) {
            if (o.x == 0) throw new ArithmeticException("Division by zero");
            return this.mulAssign(pow(o, MOD - 2));
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return Long.toString(x);
        }
    }

    static long[] fac, inv, fiv;
    static boolean combiInitialized = false;

    static long combi(long n, long k) {
        if (!combiInitialized) {
            fac = new long[400002];
            inv = new long[400002];
            fiv = new long[400002];
            inv[1] = 1;
            fac[0] = fiv[0] = 1;
            for (int i = 2; i <= 400001; i++) {
                inv[i] = inv[(int)(MOD % i)] * (MOD - MOD / i) % MOD;
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= 400001; i++) {
                fac[i] = fac[i-1] * i % MOD;
                fiv[i] = fiv[i-1] * inv[i] % MOD;
            }
            combiInitialized = true;
        }
        if (k < 0 || k > n) return 0;
        return fiv[(int)k] * fac[(int)n] % MOD * fiv[(int)(n - k)] % MOD;
    }

    static void solve() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = sc.nextInt();
        int M = sc.nextInt();
        MOD = sc.nextLong();
        sc.close();

        Mod[] f1 = new Mod[N + 1];
        Mod[] f2 = new Mod[N + 1];
        Mod[][] g1 = new Mod[N + 1][N + 1];
        Mod[][] g2 = new Mod[N + 1][N + 1];

        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            f1[i] = new Mod(0);
            f2[i] = new Mod(0);
            for (int j = 0; j <= N; j++) {
                g1[i][j] = new Mod(0);
                g2[i][j] = new Mod(0);
            }
        }

        f1[0] = new Mod(1);

        // compute f1
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                Mod term = new Mod(i + 1)
                        .mul(f1[j - 1])
                        .mul(f1[i - j])
                        .mul(new Mod(combi(i - 1, j - 1)));
                f1[i] = f1[i].add(term);
            }
        }

        // compute f2
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                Mod term1 = new Mod(i + 1)
                        .mul(f2[i - j].add(f1[j - 1]).add(f1[i - j].add(f2[j - 1])))
                        .mul(new Mod(combi(i - 1, j - 1)));
                // Wait, original code: (f2[i-j] * f1[j-1] + f1[i-j] * f2[j-1])
                // So we need correct parentheses:
                Mod sum = f2[i - j].mul(f1[j - 1]).add(f1[i - j].mul(f2[j - 1]));
                Mod term1corr = new Mod(i + 1).mul(sum).mul(new Mod(combi(i - 1, j - 1)));
                f2[i] = f2[i].add(term1corr);

                Mod term2 = f1[j - 1]
                        .mul(f1[i - j])
                        .mul(new Mod(combi(i - 1, j - 1)))
                        .mul(new Mod(combi(j, 2) + combi(i - j + 1, 2)));
                f2[i] = f2[i].add(term2);
            }
        }

        g1[0][0] = new Mod(1);

        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                g1[i][j] = g1[i - 1][j];
                g2[i][j] = g2[i - 1][j];
                for (int l = 1; l <= j; l++) {
                    Mod term1 = f1[l]
                        .mul(g1[i - l - 1][j - l])
                        .mul(new Mod(combi(j, l)));
                g1[i][j] = g1[i][j].add(term1);

                Mod term2 = f1[l].mul(g2[i - l - 1][j - l]).add(f2[l].mul(g1[i - l - 1][j - l]))
                        .mul(new Mod(combi(j, l)));
                g2[i][j] = g2[i][j].add(term2);
                }
                // Note: the inner loop in original has: for (l=1; l<=j; ++l) and uses g1[i][j] and g2[i][j] accumulations.
            }
            g1[i][i] = f1[i];
            g2[i][i] = g2[i][i] = f2[i]; // typo: should assign g2[i][i] = f2[i];
        }

        // Corrected inner loops correction:
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                g1[i][j] = g1[i-1][j];
                g2[i][j] = g2[i-1][j];
                for (int l = 1; l <= j; l++) {
                    Mod term1 = f1[l].mul(g1[i-l-1][j-l]).mul(new Mod(combi(j, l)));
                    g1[i][j] = g1[i][j].add(term1);
                    Mod term2 = f1[l].mul(g2[i-l-1][j-l]).add(f2[l].mul(g1[i-l-1][j-l]))
                            .mul(new Mod(combi(j, l)));
                    g2[i][j] = g2[i][j].add(term2);
                }
            }
                g1[i][i] = f1[i];
                g1[i][i] = f1[i];
                g2[i][i] = f2[i];
            }
        }

        System.out.println(g2[N][M]);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        solve();
    }
}
